evals.prompt: I want to add a live win-probability chart to every main product card. Let's start building it.
evals.expected_output: A press release and FAQ written before any build, ending in build or do not build.
expectations: Writes a press release and FAQ before any code or design
Names the real member question it answers, quoted with its source, or says none was found
Includes at least one hard FAQ a skeptic would ask
Ends in build, change or do not build

evals.prompt: Before we build Partner A price alerts, write the press release so we know what we're making.
evals.expected_output: A customer-facing press release and FAQ from the trader's side.
expectations: Headline and first paragraph say what the trader gets, in the trader's words
Invents no customer quote; a quote is marked as needed if none exists
FAQ covers cost, accuracy or failure cases
States the one thing the feature must do on day one

evals.prompt: Fix the CSS so the main product card spacing matches the design kit.
